physDesc.physMedium: In blue cover carrying the (later) addition: "Udkast til 'Vølvens Spaadom"'. Written in pencil. Paper: 16 staves. Scattered sketches for passages in all movements except No. 1. On p. 5 two systems in piano notation, headed "Ouverture Thema".
1 single folio and 1 bifolio. Written in pencil and ink. Paper: 12 staves. Scattered sketches for passages in Nos. 1-3, including a few sketches for works other than "Vølvens Spaadom".

Written in brown ink with additions in pencil (page numbers below the staves and rehearsal letters referring to the fair copy). Paper: 14 staves. Title on top of the first music page: "Volvens Spaadom" / af den ældre Edda, paa Dansk / ved Fr. Winkel Horn." In Nos. 2, 4 and 5 only the vocal parts are fully written out, whereas the piano part is only hinted at in certain passages. Scattered indications of instrumentation. At the end of the music on p. 29 signed and dated: "I:P:E:H: / Sommeren / 1870." On the verso of the last music page are scattered pencil additions with illegible, apparently random, music and text.

annot.p: With its corrections and additions the short score corresponds to the final version when it comes to the vocal part, the formal layout, and instrumentation (as far as it is indicated).

physDesc.physMedium: Library binding of a later date with the monogram of King Christian X. Originally bound in marbled paper. Written in ink. Paper: 24 staves. Paginated in ink: 3-64 (title page and first music page without pagination). Title on first music page: "Volvens Spaadom". The vocal parts with the text written in a different pen, apparently in foreign hand. German text later added in pencil in a third hand. Tb. 2 (and in some cases tb.1) added to the finished score in red crayon on an empty stave as the trb.b., sometimes written in notes, sometimes just indicated through "a2", "uni". etc. Below the bottom stave there are indications to the engraver about page turns; none of the existing printed editions follow these indications. End-dating: "I.P.E. Hartmann / 19/4 72."
